messages.author: 69658a5d047f38b4
messages.subject: loading ggplot2 as default package
parts:
Hello all,

I am trying to load ggplot2 when R starts since I use it almost every
time. I therefore added:

R_DEFAULT_PACKAGES='ggplot2'

to my .Renviron but this creates an error when trying to use ggplot:

$ R
R version 2.8.1 (2008-12-22)
[...]
Loading required package: proto
Loading required package: grid
Loading required package: reshape
Loading required package: plyr
> qplot(0)
Error in all.names(asOneSidedFormula(x)) :
could not find function "asOneSidedFormula"

while it works when loading ggplot manually:

$ R
R version 2.8.1 (2008-12-22)
[...]
> library(ggplot2)
Loading required package: proto
Loading required package: grid
Loading required package: reshape
Loading required package: plyr
Attaching package: 'ggplot2'
The following object(s) are masked from package:grid :
nullGrob
> qplot(0)

This looks like a bug. I'm using R 2.8.1 and ggplot2 0.8.1 on Mac OS X.

Thanks in advance.

JiHO

messages.subject: Re: loading ggplot2 as default package
parts:
Hi Jiho,

I suspect the problem is you're replacing the list of default
packages, not supplementing it. I use a .Rprofile file containing
something like:

.First <- function() {
library(ggplot2)
}

Regards,

Hadley
